source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将定，静压将翻
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC35 after EP02 SC34 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the point where exposed truth and cracking restraint are almost irreversible into the next threshold: Keshadu's conclusion is nearly fixed, Shisilang's fury hovers at overt rupture, Tuobaye is almost completely spent, and the white-clothed woman's restraint is poised on the very edge of visible overturn.
title: 真相将定，静压将翻

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC34 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC34 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相欲定，十四郎怒线欲裂，拓拔野将要枯竭，白衣女子的静压已到欲裂边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这条线继续推到真正不可逆的前夜。科沙度的判断已经几乎固定，十四郎的怒势也快撕开表面平衡，拓拔野只剩极少余力，而白衣女子的克制已经接近必须翻面的门槛。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线从欲裂推进到真正快要翻面的程度，为明确的出手或揭露做最后一层推进。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and restrained until the true source beat forces the visible break; avoid false spectacle before the actual turn.
Keshadu should feel nearly fixed in certainty.
Shisilang remains unstable and close to rupture.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: near-fixed truth, rupture-edge fury, near-empty endurance, and cracking restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
